title: feat(crm): Complete metadata enhancement — reports, junction objects, seed data, pages, branding, file splitting
body:
The CRM example had empty `reports[]`, minimal seed data (2 users, 2 orders), no junction objects for many-to-many relationships, a single page, incomplete branding, and all metadata inlined in a single ~985-line config file. This PR fills all gaps per the issue checklist and restructures metadata into separate files.

### P0 — Reports & Navigation
- Added **Sales Report** and **Pipeline Report** using `@objectstack/spec` report format (`type: 'summary'`, `columns` with `aggregate`, `groupingsDown`, `chart` with `xAxis`/`yAxis`)
- Navigation uses native `type: 'report'` items grouped under a "Reports" nav group

### P1 — Seed Data & Junction Objects
- **Users**: 2 → 7 records (admin, manager, user, viewer roles + inactive)
- **Orders**: 2 → 7 records covering all 6 statuses (draft/pending/paid/shipped/delivered/cancelled)
- **Products**: +2 inactive (`is_active: false`) for filter testing
- **`order_items`**: New junction object (Order ↔ Product) with quantity, unit_price, discount, line_total, item_type — 12 seed records
- **`opportunity_contacts`**: New junction object (Opportunity ↔ Contact) with role/is_primary — 7 seed records
- **Event attendees**: `participants` field populated on all 6 event records

### P2 — Dashboard & Branding
- Added "Revenue by Account" widget using `provider: 'object'` with aggregation
- Added `logo`, `favicon` to app branding (note: `backgroundColor` is not supported by the `@objectstack/spec` branding type)

### P3 — Pages
- **Settings** page (utility type) — general config, notifications, integrations, data management
- **Getting Started** page — onboarding walkthrough (team setup, data import, pipeline config, reports)

### Metadata File Splitting
All inline metadata extracted from `objectstack.config.ts` into separate files, reducing the config from ~985 lines to a clean 122-line orchestration file:
```
examples/crm/src/
  reports/     — sales.report.ts, pipeline.report.ts
  pages/       — help.page.ts, settings.page.ts, getting_started.page.ts
  dashboards/  — crm.dashboard.ts
  apps/        — crm.app.ts
  data/        — 10 per-object seed data files (account, contact, opportunity, user, product, order, project_task, event, order_item, opportunity_contact)
  objects/     — order_item.object.ts, opportunity_contact.object.ts (new)
  views/       — order_item.view.ts, opportunity_contact.view.ts (new)
  actions/     — order_item.actions.ts, opportunity_contact.actions.ts (new)
```

ROADMAP.md updated with CRM Example Metadata Enhancement section.

> ### P0（最高优先级）
> 1. **报告元数据完善**

>    - Navigation 不再依赖 shared config hack，必须原生支持 report 跳转。

> ### P1
> 2. **Seed Data 深度扩展**
>    - user 数据增加至少 5 个（覆盖不同角色/权限场景）
>    - order 数据扩展，覆盖各种状态、金额、客户类型
>    - 产品数据增加至少 2 个 `is_active: false`（用于 inactive 过滤测试）
> 
> 3. **Order ↔ Product junction/join 支持**
>    - 新增 `order_items` object，实现订单与产品的多对多关系
>    - 含 line item 字段，如数量、价格、折扣、item type
> 
> 4. **Relationship 数据更多样化**
>    - Opportunity ↔ Contact 多对多关系示例引入 junction object
>    - Contact ↔ Event (attendees) 关联示例
>

> 5. **Dashboard 动态数据能力展示**
>    - 增加一个 widget 使用 `provider: 'query'`，从 object 数据动态聚合 KPI（如按 Account/Opportunity 汇总）
> 
> 6. **App Branding 完善**
>    - 增加 `logo`、`favicon`、`description`、`backgroundColor` 等，展示全部 AppSchema Branding 能力
> 
> ---
>

> 7. **Pages 丰富**
>    - 增加至少 2 个页面：Settings、Onboarding/Getting Started
>    - 页面 Schema 标准化，体现 SDUI 灵活性
